news.title: James feeling good and can’t wait for the season to start
news.title_zh: 詹姆斯感觉很好，迫不及待地等待赛季开始
news.body_en: Reece James believes Chelsea’s friendly win over Real Sociedad showed he and the team’s preparations for the new season are on course and our skipper can’t wait for it to begin. The Blues’ final fixture of pre-season brought us back to Stamford Bridge after our tour of Asia and Australia, as the last members of Xabi Alonso’s squad – including James – returned to action following their post-World Cup break. With a week to go until the campaign kicks off, it was a promising performance from the Blues, as Morgan Rogers marked his first appearance for the club with the opening goal and Joao Pedro netted twice to give us a 3-1 win over Real Sociedad. Our captain featured for the first hour of that victory and was pleased with another step forward in pre-season for him and his team-mates. ‘It was a good performance from the team,’ said James. ‘I’m happy to be back out there and the season starts this time in a week. ‘The break’s been pretty short so I felt pretty good out there yesterday. The conditions were tough, it was super hot, but I’m feeling good. ‘It’s still early, there was a bit of rust still to come off, but yesterday was a good step. ‘It was a short break, probably shorter than everyone would have liked, but I’m delighted to be back and the new season’s going to be getting under way pretty soon.’ James and the rest of the Blues who were involved in the latter stages of the World Cup with their countries over the summer returned to training at Cobham last week, with Alonso speaking publicly about the importance of having our captain back in the squad. ‘It means a lot coming from a manager and an ex-player of his calibre,’ Reece responded. ‘It means a lot so hopefully I can give my all for him and deliver when I’m needed most. ‘They’ve just come off the pre-season tour which was a lot of travelling, a lot of games, but from what I’ve seen everyone’s settled in well and I’m delighted with the group. ‘It’s only been four or five days, it’s been super short, but I’m enjoying it very much so far and that’s the same for the boys.’ With the pre-season games now completed, the next time James and Chelsea take to the pitch will be in competitive action, with one week to go until the Premier League begins. For the Blues, that means taking the short trip up the road to face neighbours Fulham at Craven Cottage on the evening of Monday 24 August. ‘It’s a super difficult London derby to start off our Premier League campaign but we’re excited and the preparation for that will start pretty soon. I can’t wait!’
news.body_zh: 里斯·詹姆斯相信切尔西对皇家社会的友谊赛表明他和球队为新赛季的准备工作正在按部就班，我们的队长已经迫不及待地等待它的开始。在亚洲和澳大利亚之旅结束后，蓝军季前赛的最后一场比赛将我们带回斯坦福桥，哈维·阿隆索队的最后一批成员——包括詹姆斯——在世界杯结束后重返赛场。距离赛季开始还有一周时间，蓝军的表现令人期待，摩根·罗杰斯首次为俱乐部出场就打入首球，若奥·佩德罗梅开二度帮助我们以 3-1 战胜皇家社会。我们的队长在这场胜利的第一个小时中表现出色，并对他和他的队友在季前赛中又向前迈出了一步感到高兴。 “球队的表现很好，”詹姆斯说。 “我很高兴回到那里，赛季在一周后的这个时候开始。 “休息时间很短，所以我昨天感觉很好。条件很艰苦，天气超级热，但我感觉很好。 “现在还早，还有一点锈迹需要去除，但昨天已经迈出了良好的一步。 “这是一次短暂的休息，可能比每个人都希望的要短，但我很高兴能回来，新赛季很快就会开始。”詹姆斯和其他在夏天随国家队参加世界杯后期的蓝军球员上周回到了科巴姆训练，阿隆索公开谈到了让我们的队长回到球队的重要性。 “这对于一位像他这样有能力的教练和前球员来说意义重大，”里斯回答道。 “这意义重大，所以希望我能为他付出一切，并在他最需要我的时候做出贡献。 “他们刚刚结束季前赛，这是很多旅行，很多比赛，但从我所看到的情况来看，每个人都适应得很好，我对这支球队感到很高兴。 “只有四五天，非常短，但到目前为止我非常享受，对于孩子们来说也是如此。”随着季前赛的结束，詹姆斯和切尔西下次上场将进行激烈的比赛，距离英超联赛开始还有一周时间。对于蓝军来说，这意味着 8 月 24 日星期一晚上在克雷文小屋迎战邻居富勒姆。 “对于我们的英超联赛来说，这是一场超级艰难的伦敦德比，但我们很兴奋，准备工作很快就会开始。我等不及了！

news.title: Xabi Alonso delighted to have ‘quality’ Reece James back
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索很高兴“高品质”里斯·詹姆斯回归
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was able to use Reece James for the first time in pre-season during our 3-1 defeat of Real Sociedad, and our manager explained why he is so pleased to have the Blues captain at his disposal. Having been a member of England’s squad which finished third at this summer’s World Cup, James only returned to training earlier this week. So Alonso has now had the chance to work with him on the pitches at Cobham, and see him in action from the touchline during a match. Our manager is well placed to outline the qualities James brings to the side. ‘Personality, leadership, experience, quality, composure with the ball, competitiveness without the ball,’ said Alonso. ‘He’s very flexible in his style and in different positions, he’s a legend in the club, and he is a key player for the team.’ James was not the only player to return to training this week. Like our skipper, new signings Maxence Lacroix and Morgan Rogers got an hour against Sociedad, with the latter opening the scoring in Saturday’s sunny victory in SW6. Alonso gave his verdict on those who were back on the pitch following their extended involvement at the World Cup. ‘They did quite well to play this well after just three days of training,’ said Alonso. ‘It’s early days and there is so much to connect and improve and live together, but the most important is the hunger and the desire they have to want to have a great season and create a good feeling in the team that will transmit to the rest. ‘Most of the players are fit to train. The fitness levels of some are higher than others after pre-season, but all of them will be good. We plan to have five training sessions before the Fulham game now and that’s the main focus.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在季前赛以 3-1 击败皇家社会队的比赛中首次使用里斯·詹姆斯，我们的主教练解释了为什么他如此高兴蓝军队长可以为他所用。作为今年夏天世界杯上获得第三名的英格兰队的一员，詹姆斯在本周早些时候才恢复训练。因此，阿隆索现在有机会在科巴姆的球场上与他一起工作，并在比赛中在边线观看他的比赛。我们的经理非常有能力概述詹姆斯所带来的品质。 “个性、领导力、经验、素质、有球时的冷静、无球时的竞争力，”阿隆索说。 “他的风格非常灵活，在不同的位置上都非常灵活，他是俱乐部的传奇人物，也是球队的关键球员。”詹姆斯并不是本周唯一恢复训练的球员。和我们的队长一样，新加盟的马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和摩根·罗杰斯在对阵皇家社会队的比赛中获得了一个小时的出场时间，后者在周六 SW6 的阳光明媚的胜利中首开纪录。阿隆索对那些长期参加世界杯后重返赛场的球员做出了评价。 “他们在仅仅三天的训练后就能打出这样的成绩，他们做得很好，”阿隆索说道。 “现在还处于早期阶段，有很多东西需要联系、改进和共同生活，但最重要的是他们的渴望和渴望，想要度过一个美好的赛季，并在球队中创造一种良好的感觉，这种感觉会传递给其他人。 “大多数球员都适合训练。季前赛结束后，有些人的体能水平比其他人要高，但所有人都会很好。我们计划在与富勒姆的比赛之前进行五次训练，这是主要焦点。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on a productive final friendly and ‘emotional’ Stamford Bridge reception
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在斯坦福桥举办了富有成效的最后一场友谊赛和“激动人心的”招待会
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was pleased with the effort his players put in against Real Sociedad in our final pre-season friendly of the summer, on a day when our new manager felt right at home at Stamford Bridge. The Blues defeated the side from San Sebastian 3-1, with Morgan Rogers opening his Chelsea account early on and Joao Pedro providing two typically clinical goals to seal the victory in the second half. Alonso was afforded the opportunity to use several members of his squad for the first time in pre-season, including the likes of Rogers, Maxence Lacroix and Reece James – all of whom went far at the FIFA World Cup. ‘It was a very good last preparation game,’ assessed Alonso afterwards. ‘For some players it was the first one and the last one. For us, there were some good things, some things we can improve. It’s normal at this moment for some players. ‘It was great to have all the team together. Some of them after three days could play for 60 minutes. It was the last test. Now we have a whole week to prepare for Fulham, but it was a good feeling in the stadium.’ Alonso admitted to being moved by the rapturous ovation he received from the Blues fans inside Stamford Bridge ahead of kick-off when he was introduced to the crowd at his first home game (pictured top). He knows how important the relationship between the team and Blues faithful will be, with the positive feeling today auguring well for the campaign ahead. ‘It was emotional to feel my first time in the new home,’ said Alonso. ‘A great reception from the supporters to the team and to the new staff, myself as well, so delighted. ‘We want to create good connections and have that support. We want to give them good football so they will give us energy, and we connect. To have a good atmosphere here in the stadium will be a massive boost for the team.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对他的球员在今年夏天最后一场季前友谊赛对阵皇家社会队的比赛中所付出的努力感到满意，这一天我们的新主帅在斯坦福桥感到宾至如归。蓝军以 3-1 击败了圣塞巴斯蒂安队，摩根·罗杰斯早早打开了他的切尔西账户，而若奥·佩德罗则在下半场打进了两个典型的冷静进球，锁定了胜利。阿隆索在季前赛中首次有机会使用球队的几名球员，其中包括罗杰斯、马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦和里斯·詹姆斯等人——他们都在国际足联世界杯上走得很远。 “这是一场非常好的最后一场准备比赛，”阿隆索赛后评价道。 “对于一些球员来说，这是第一个也是最后一个。对我们来说，有一些好的事情，有一些我们可以改进的事情。对于某些玩家来说，此时这是正常的。 “所有团队聚集在一起真是太好了。有些人三天后就能玩60分钟。这是最后一次测试。现在我们有一整周的时间来为富勒姆做准备，但在球场里的感觉很好。”阿隆索承认，当他在第一场主场比赛中被介绍给观众时（上图），开球前斯坦福桥球场内蓝军球迷的热烈鼓掌令他感动不已。他知道球队和蓝军球迷之间的关系有多么重要，今天的积极情绪预示着接下来的赛季会有好结果。 “第一次来到新家的感觉很激动，”阿隆索说。 “支持者、球队和新员工以及我自己都受到了热烈的欢迎，非常高兴。 “我们希望建立良好的联系并获得这种支持。我们希望为他们提供精彩的足球，这样他们就会给我们能量，我们之间就会产生联系。体育场内良好的氛围将为球队带来巨大的推动力。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 3-1 Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 3-1 皇家社会
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers marked his first game in Chelsea colours with a goal and Joao Pedro added to his impressive summer tally by bagging a brace as Xabi Alonso’s Blues ended our pre-season schedule in style. On a sizzling summer’s afternoon in west London, Rogers poked us ahead early on after Joao Pedro’s header had been well saved. Sociedad carried a threat of their own and levelled shortly before the half-time whistle courtesy of Jon Mikel Aramburu’s fine volley. However, the second half was very much Chelsea’s, and our dominance was rewarded through a pair of Joao Pedro goals - his sixth and seventh of pre-season. The well-placed header that restored our lead arrived a couple of minutes into the second half, and the Brazilian backed that up by making a one-on-one opportunity look very easy as this enjoyable friendly entered its final act. Xabi Alonso, getting his first taste of the  home dugout at the Bridge, was able to give minutes to 20 of his players, including several who had yet to feature this pre-season. For the Blues fans watching on, it whet the appetite for what lies ahead, with the start of the Premier League campaign just over a week away now. Before kick-off, Alonso received a great ovation from the Chelsea supporters inside the stadium, and indeed the small pocket of travelling fans who saw him come through Real Sociedad’s ranks in the late nineties. Alonso’s first Stamford Bridge starting XI included new signings Marco Palestra, Maxence Lacroix and Rogers. The latter two were playing their first game for us having returned to training earlier in the week. The shape was nominally 3-4-3, with Pedro Neto and Palestra the wing-backs. Reece James joined Moises Caicedo in midfield, with Cole Palmer and Rogers – as well as Neto and Palestra – supporting Joao Pedro. It was apparent from the off how fluid the attack would be, with Joao Pedro regularly dropping deeper, allowing Rogers and Palmer to run beyond. However, it was from Joao Pedro’s positioning in a central striking position that we took the lead in the tenth minute. Neto teased a cross in from the right flank and the Brazilian’s header back across goal was well directed. Visiting keeper Alex Remiro, diving to his left, just reached it but succeeded only in teeing up Rogers, who couldn’t miss in front of the Shed. Joao Pedro almost immediately forced Remiro into another good save, with nobody in blue able to pick up the pieces on this occasion. Sociedad then threatened for the first time, Ander Barrenetxea cutting inside and curling a shot not far wide. Either side of a hydration break, which offered both teams some respite on another scorching London afternoon, Take Kubo shot into the side-netting and Rob Sanchez produced a superb reaction save to deny Jon Martin. It looked like we had quietened the Sociedad threat sufficiently before the break, but the side from San Sebastian equalised on the stroke of half-time through Arambaru’s brilliantly executed 20-yard volley. Sanchez stood no chance. The Blues came out of the blocks quickly and soon restored our lead, in similar fashion to the opener. Palmer twisted back and forth before laying the ball off for James to send over a right-wing cross. Joao Pedro rose highest and this time his header was steered beyond Remiro’s reach. Another attack involving Palmer ended with the Brazilian firing against Remiro’s legs as the angle narrowed, and there was plenty more slick interplay for the home fans to enjoy as we approached the hour mark. The first ranch of changes saw Mike Penders, Malo Gusto, Josh Acheampong and Enzo Fernandez enter the fray. Gusto went to right wing-back, with Neto switching to the left. One of Sociedad’s subs, Spain World Cup winner Mikel Oyarzabal, had a shot excellently blocked by Wesley Fofana shortly after coming on. But it was our leading man who was more decisive following another flurry of Blues subs – including a first sighting of Pep Chavarria in blue. Gusto played a fine through pass for Joao Pedro to run on to, and the confident finish that followed across Remiro felt inevitable. We continued to look threatening in the final quarter-hour, with Estevao shooting over and Jorrel Hato embarking on a lung-busting run from one end to the other that had the Blues fans roaring him on. It epitomised an enjoyable finale to pre-season. The Premier League season! The Blues begin the 2026/27 campaign by making the short trip to Craven Cottage to play Fulham next Monday 24 August. news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯以进球标志着他在切尔西队的首场比赛，若昂·佩德罗则梅开二度，为他令人印象深刻的夏季进球增添了色彩，哈维·阿隆索的蓝军以时尚的方式结束了我们的季前赛。在伦敦西部一个炎热的夏日午后，若昂·佩德罗的头球被很好地扑出后，罗杰斯一早就为我们取得了领先。皇家社会队也构成了自己的威胁，并在半场结束前不久凭借乔恩·米克尔·阿兰布鲁的精彩抽射将比分扳平。然而，下半场很大程度上是切尔西的比赛，我们的统治地位通过若昂·佩德罗的两粒进球得到了回报——这是他季前赛的第六粒和第七粒进球。下半场开始几分钟后，巴西人的头球定位得当，帮助我们恢复了领先优势，而巴西人则在这场令人愉快的友谊赛进入最后一幕时，轻松地创造了一对一的机会。哈维·阿隆索第一次在蓝桥尝到了主场的滋味，他给了 20 名球员上场时间，其中包括几名尚未在季前赛上场的球员。对于正在观看的蓝军球迷来说，这激发了他们对未来的兴趣，距离英超联赛的开始只有一周多了。开球前，阿隆索受到了球场内切尔西球迷的热烈鼓掌，甚至还有一小部分在上世纪九十年代末看到他在皇家社会队中崭露头角的客场球迷。阿隆索在斯坦福桥的首发阵容包括新签约的马科·帕莱斯特拉、马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦和罗杰斯。后两人是我们在本周早些时候恢复训练后的第一场比赛。名义上的阵型是3-4-3，佩德罗·内托和帕莱斯特拉担任边后卫。里斯·詹姆斯与莫伊塞斯·凯塞多一起出任中场，科尔·帕尔默和罗杰斯以及内托和帕莱斯特拉为若昂·佩德罗提供支持。从一开始就可以看出进攻的流畅性，若昂·佩德罗经常回撤更深，让罗杰斯和帕尔默跑得更远。然而，正是由于若奥·佩德罗在中路的位置，我们在第10分钟取得了领先。内托从右翼挑传，巴西人的头球攻门精准。来访的守门员亚历克斯·雷米罗（Alex Remiro）向他的左侧猛扑，刚刚到达球门，但只成功地将罗杰斯（Rogers）开球，而罗杰斯（Rogers）在棚屋前不能错过。若昂·佩德罗几乎立即迫使雷米罗做出了另一次精彩扑救，这次蓝衣无人能收拾残局。随后，社会队首次发起威胁，安德·巴雷内特西亚内切，一脚弧线射门偏出。在另一个炎热的伦敦下午，补水休息为两支球队提供了一些喘息的机会，久保建的射门打入边网，罗布·桑切斯做出了精彩的扑救，挡出了乔恩·马丁的球门。看起来我们在中场休息前已经充分平息了皇家社会的威胁，但圣塞巴斯蒂安队在半场结束前通过阿兰巴鲁出色的 20 码凌空抽射扳平了比分。桑切斯没有机会。蓝军很快就走出了禁区，很快就恢复了领先优势，就像揭幕战一样。帕尔默前后转身，然后将球传给詹姆斯，后者传出右翼传中。若昂·佩德罗（Joao Pedro）最高，这一次他的头球超出了雷米罗的范围。帕尔默的另一次进攻以巴西人在角度缩小时向雷米罗的腿开火而告终，当我们接近一小时时，主场球迷可以享受更多流畅的互动。第一个变化是迈克·潘德斯 (Mike news.title: Alonso outlines football philosophy as matchday programme returns

news.body_en: As Chelsea return to Stamford Bridge for a final pre-season friendly against Real Sociedad on Saturday, the matchday programme also returns, featuring an interview with Xabi Alonso. The new manager discusses his upbringing in the Basque Country, his footballing family and the journey he has taken to the top of the game, winning silverware with Spanish, English and German clubs, as well as becoming a two-time European champion and World Cup-winner in the international game. He also discusses his outlook as a coach and how it has been informed by his experiences. 'I would say that it’s about the collective responsibility,' he says of his approach. 'I think that we have always had that view to always feel responsible about teamwork – how can I help my team-mate? How can I prepare a strategic vision to achieve this goal? It’s very much there in the Basque society, and that’s continuous in the way we view football, as players and as managers in this case. '[Those values] live with me,' he adds, 'so I will transmit them to the players, because I don’t understand football in any other way than with these fundamentals, knowing that the team is always the most important. For sure, the individuals count so much, but always for the benefit of the team.' We introduce you to the new faces in the squad this season and take a look at the Spanish influence on the club over the years as we prepare to face La Liga opposition. Then there are all the key stats and facts from last season, as well as a round-up of pre-season so far and Chelsea players’ participation at the FIFA World Cup. We also pay tribute to the late Bobby Tambling and Ken Bates, who we lost over the course of the close season. Pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge, or order online from our official publications partner, Reach Sport.
news.body_zh: 周六，切尔西将返回斯坦福桥，与皇家社会队进行最后一场季前友谊赛，比赛日节目也将回归，其中包括对哈维·阿隆索的采访。新任主教练讲述了他在巴斯克地区的成长经历、他的足球家庭以及他登上足球巅峰的历程，包括随西班牙、英国和德国俱乐部赢得奖杯，并在国际比赛中成为两届欧洲冠军和世界杯冠军。他还讨论了他作为教练的看法以及他的经历如何影响他的看法。 “我想说这是关于集体责任，”他谈到自己的方法时说道。 “我认为我们一直都有这样的观点，即始终对团队合作负责——我怎样才能帮助我的队友？我如何制定战略愿景来实现这一目标？这在巴斯克社会中非常普遍，而且这在我们看待足球的方式中是持续的，无论是作为球员还是作为教练。 “[这些价值观]与我同在，”他补充道，“所以我会将它们传递给球员，因为除了这些基本原则之外，我不会以任何其他方式理解足球，因为我知道球队永远是最重要的。”当然，个人很重要，但总是为了团队的利益。”我们向您介绍本赛季球队中的新面孔，并在我们准备面对西甲对手时了解西班牙多年来对俱乐部的影响。然后是上赛季的所有关键数据和事实，以及迄今为止季前赛的汇总以及切尔西球员参加国际足联世界杯的情况。我们还要向已故的鲍比·坦布林和肯·贝茨致敬，我们在上个赛季失去了他们。从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处获取您的副本，或从我们的官方出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。

news.title: Dastan Satpayev completes Chelsea transfer and seals loan switch
news.title_zh: 达斯坦·萨帕耶夫完成切尔西转会并确定租借转换
news.body_en: Chelsea is pleased to confirm that Kazakhstan international Dastan Satpayev has officially joined from FC Kairat, with the forward moving to Championship side Burnley on loan for the upcoming season. Satpayev has signed a contract with the Blues until 2033 and will spend the 2026/27 campaign at Turf Moor, having been part of Chelsea's travelling squad for our summer tour of Australia and Asia. He featured in four of our fixtures during the trip and scored in our victory over Western Sydney Wanderers. Capable of playing across the attack, Satpayev spent his formative years with Kairat and was handed his first-team debut aged 15 in May 2024. He went on to make 58 first-team appearances for the club, including outings in the UEFA Champions League, and struck 26 goals. Satpayev’s performances for Kairat earned him senior international recognition in March 2025. He became Kazakhstan’s youngest ever debutant (16 years, seven months and ten days) and has gone on to make eight appearances for his country so far. His first goal for Kazakhstan was struck in November 2025 in a 1-1 draw against Belgium, making him the youngest player (17 years, three months and three days) to find the net for his country. Everyone at Chelsea wishes Dastan well for the season ahead and we look forward to monitoring and supporting his development.
news.body_zh: 切尔西很高兴地确认哈萨克斯坦国脚达斯坦·萨特帕耶夫已正式从凯拉特足球俱乐部加盟，这名前锋在下个赛季租借到英冠球队伯恩利。萨帕耶夫已与蓝军签订了一份到2033年到期的合同，并将在Turf Moor度过2026/27赛季，他是切尔西随队参加夏季澳大利亚和亚洲之旅的一员。旅途中他参加了我们的四场比赛，并在我们战胜西悉尼流浪者队的比赛中进球。萨帕耶夫能够胜任进攻，在凯拉特度过了自己的成长岁月，并于 2024 年 5 月在 15 岁时首次代表一线队出场。随后，他为俱乐部一线队出场 58 次，其中包括欧洲冠军联赛，并打进 26 个进球。 2025 年 3 月，萨特帕耶夫在凯拉特队的表现为他赢得了国际认可。他成为哈萨克斯坦有史以来最年轻的首次亮相（16 岁零 7 个月零 10 天），迄今为止已为国家队出场 8 次。他代表哈萨克斯坦队的首个进球是在 2025 年 11 月 1-1 战平比利时的比赛中打进的，这使他成为为哈萨克斯坦队进球的最年轻球员（17 岁零三个月零三天）。切尔西的每个人都祝愿达斯坦在未来的赛季一切顺利，我们期待着监督和支持他的发展。

news.title: Dress for Summer of ’26 with Chelsea’s Summer of ’64 range
news.title_zh: 切尔西 64 年夏季系列的 26 年夏季连衣裙
news.body_en: The sun is out, just like it was over six decades ago when the Blues made a big impact on a tour of the Caribbean where the local culture also had an impact on the team. Now for cool clothing with a summer splash, we have some eye-catching designs inspired by that same culture and Chelsea heritage, and by vintage travel posters and postcards, harking back to an era of international travel defined by glamour, adventure and wonder. The Summer of ’64 range collects together a short-sleeve shirt, a t-shirt and a pair of shorts all featuring themes familiar from the visit to the West Indies by Tommy Docherty’s vibrant young side. Back then, 11 games were played in under three weeks on four different islands and a 7-0 win over a Barbados side was sufficient to persuade their goalkeeper, Keith Boyce, to switch his full attention to cricket, a sport in which he became a West Indies all-time great. The Summer of ’64 range follows cricket clothing in choosing seasonal white as its main colour, which was also the case for a very rarely worn Chelsea away shirt which, with its thin single blue and white hoops, did see action during the Caribbean games. That heritage image features along with other tropical motifs on the Summer of ‘64 shirt, as does a sound system. So taken were the players with Eric ‘Monty’ Morris’s ska song Sammy Dead that they brought a copy back and persuaded the Stamford Bridge DJs to play it, beginning a long association with Jamaican-inspired music at Chelsea which continues today with Liquidator. The sound system design is the main feature, on the back, of the Summer of ’64 t-shirt. The lightweight shorts in contrasting blue have the era-appropriate Chelsea badge embroidered on them. You can shop for summer in the Megastore at Stamford Bridge on Saturday when we play Real Sociedad, and the Summer of ’64 range is also available in the online store
news.body_zh: 太阳出来了，就像六十多年前一样，当时蓝军在加勒比海之旅中产生了巨大影响，当地文化也对球队产生了影响。现在，对于夏季流行的酷炫服装，我们推出了一些引人注目的设计，其灵感源自相同的文化和切尔西传统，以及复古旅行海报和明信片，让人回想起以魅力、冒险和奇迹为定义的国际旅行时代。 Summer of ’64 系列汇集了短袖衬衫、T 恤和短裤，所有主题均与 Tommy Docherty 充满活力的年轻一面访问西印度群岛时所熟悉的主题相同。当时，不到三周的时间，在四个不同的岛屿上进行了 11 场比赛，7-0 战胜巴巴多斯队的比赛足以说服他们的门将基思·博伊斯 (Keith Boyce) 将全部注意力转向板球运动，他在这项运动中成为了西印度群岛历史上最伟大的运动员。 Summer of '64 系列沿袭板球服装选择季节性白色作为主色调，这也是很少穿的切尔西客场球衣的情况，该球衣采用薄薄的单蓝色和白色箍，在加勒比海比赛中确实出现过。这一传统形象与其他热带图案一起出现在 Summer of ‘64 衬衫上，音响系统也是如此。球员们对 Eric ‘Monty’ Morris 的 ska 歌曲《Sammy Dead》如此着迷，他们带回了一份副本并说服斯坦福桥的 DJ 播放这首歌，从而开始了与切尔西的牙买加音乐的长期合作，这种合作至今仍在 Liquidator 中延续。音响系统设计是 Summer of '64 T 恤背面的主要特征。对比色蓝色的轻质短裤上绣有适合时代的切尔西徽章。周六我们对阵皇家社会队时，您可以在斯坦福桥的 Megastore 购买夏季商品，在线商店也有售 64 年夏季系列

news.title: Mykhailo Mudryk on his 'really happy moment' and mission to aid return
news.title_zh: 米哈伊洛·穆德里克谈他的“真正快乐的时刻”和援助回归的使命
news.body_en: Mykhailo Mudryk has expressed his delight at being back on the training pitch with his Chelsea team-mates and detailed the strict routine he maintained to ensure he could make an immediate return to action. Following 20 months on the sidelines, Mudryk was cleared to return this summer after the anti-proceedings that had kept him out of action since December 2024 were resolved. The Ukraine international linked up with the Blues squad during our pre-season tour of Australia and Asia, and made his return to the pitch as a substitute in our friendly against Juventus in Hong Kong. Along with his Chelsea team-mates, Mudryk is now back at Cobham as manager Xabi Alonso puts the finishing touches on our squad's preparations for the forthcoming campaign – and the 25-year-old couldn’t be happier to be back. ‘Of course I’m very happy,’ said Mudryk. ‘It's been a while, so to stand back at the same training ground, it's a really happy moment for me. ‘I feel good, I feel great. I'm grateful to be back on the pitch. It was such a nice feeling to see everyone again. It was a warm welcome. ‘I missed a lot of the process, the training sessions, games especially, to compete to win and to always be hungry for more.’ Many of Mudryk’s Chelsea team-mates have mentioned how impressed they have been with the fitness levels the Ukrainian has shown on his return, and he filled us in on the training routine he observed to ensure he could come back in the best shape possible. ‘I'd say it was like a pre-season for 18 months,’ he continued. ‘So I've been training, I've been training hard. I didn't give up and I just tried to work as hard as I could. ‘I was working six days a week with proper recovery, with proper sleep schedule, food, everything. Everything was the same, just double sessions per day. ‘It was to come back and to show myself again in the football world. That was my mission and I knew what I had to do for that. Only through hard work can you reach something.’
news.body_zh: 米哈伊洛·穆德里克表达了他很高兴能与切尔西队友一起回到训练场，并详细介绍了他为确保能够立即恢复比赛而保持的严格日常安排。经过 20 个月的休养，自 2024 年 12 月以来穆德里克一直无法参加比赛的反诉讼得到解决后，穆德里克获准于今年夏天回归。这位乌克兰国脚在我们的澳大利亚和亚洲季前赛期间与蓝军队进行了会合，并在我们在香港对阵尤文图斯的友谊赛中以替补身份重返球场。穆德里克现在与他的切尔西队友一起回到了科巴姆，主教练哈比·阿隆索正在为我们球队为即将到来的赛季做最后的准备工作——这位 25 岁的球员很高兴能回来。 “我当然很高兴，”穆德里克说。 “已经有一段时间了，能够回到同一个训练场，这对我来说真的是一个快乐的时刻。 ‘我感觉很好，我感觉很棒。我很感激能够回到球场。再次见到大家的感觉真好。这是一个热烈的欢迎。 “我错过了很多过程，特别是训练课程，尤其是比赛，为了赢得比赛而竞争，并且总是渴望更多。”穆德里克的许多切尔西队友都提到，乌克兰人回归后所表现出的健康水平给他们留下了深刻的印象，他向我们介绍了他观察到的训练程序，以确保他能够以最佳状态回归。 “我想说这就像 18 个月的季前赛，”他继续说道。 “所以我一直在训练，我一直在刻苦训练。我没有放弃，只是尽我所能地努力工作。 “我每周工作六天，恢复得很好，睡眠、食物、一切都正常。一切都一样，只是每天两次。 “我是为了回来并再次在足球界展示自己。这是我的使命，我知道我必须为此做什么。只有通过努力，你才能有所成就。”

news.title_zh: Bompastor 感谢巡演中的热烈欢迎和家庭价值观
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has reflected on a successful pre-season tour for Chelsea Women, with a 100 per cent record on the pitch and an incredible experience with our supporters off it, which she got to share with her family. In terms of preparations for the coming campaign, things went pretty much perfectly for Bompastor and her Blues squad during their time visiting Australia and New Zealand this summer. That was underlined by their performances on the pitch, recording an emphatic 7-0 victory over Auckland to open pre-season, before another impressive performance to round off the trip by beating the A-League All-Stars 3-0. However, it was the warm welcome Chelsea received from the local supporters in both countries which drew our head coach’s attention as she reflected on the pre-season tour. ‘Off the pitch it was a great opportunity for us to connect with our fans in Sydney and before that in Auckland,’ she said. ‘Being able to come with the team, staff, players and to be around people who have such a strong culture, different from what we have in Europe, it's also really nice, and we really enjoyed that. We felt from the beginning a warm welcome from everyone. ‘It was just great to be there and to enjoy being together, to get to know each other better in a different environment.’ This tour was extra special for Bompastor, as she was able to experience it with her children, who joined the team for this trip. That left the Frenchwoman grateful to Chelsea for another example of how the club supports its staff and fosters a family atmosphere within the team. ‘For me, I think it's crucial as a woman,’ Bompastor explained. ‘I feel really lucky to have a club that supports me on that and being able to do my job with a lot of responsibility. ‘It's a full-time job, but they have allowed me to bring my kids with me on this journey, giving them the opportunity to experience this tour, this trip. ‘The culture there is so strong and for me to be able to share that with my children, I think it's just so special and unique. I feel lucky to be able to do that. ‘I want to thank my club for giving me the opportunity to do that as well, and I want to encourage more women to be able to find the right balance between a professional job and a personal life. ‘For me, this job is so intense. There is a lot of responsibility, but with my family being next to me and being able to experience these trips and these tours, I think it gives me the right balance. ‘It gives me the opportunity to switch off sometimes and not always be 100 per cent focused on football. That means I can be the best version of myself.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托回顾了切尔西女足成功的季前之旅，她在球场上取得了 100% 的战绩，在球场外与我们的支持者一起度过了令人难以置信的经历，她与家人分享了这些经历。在为即将到来的赛季做准备方面，邦帕斯特和她的蓝军球队在今年夏天访问澳大利亚和新西兰期间，一切进展得非常完美。他们在球场上的表现凸显了这一点，在季前赛中以 7-0 大胜奥克兰队，随后又以 3-0 击败澳超全明星队的另一场令人印象深刻的表现为旅程画上了圆满的句号。然而，切尔西受到两国当地球迷的热烈欢迎，引起了我们主教练的注意，她在回顾季前之旅时说道。 “在场外，这对我们来说是一个很好的机会，可以与悉尼的球迷以及之前在奥克兰的球迷建立联系，”她说。 “能够与球队、工作人员、球员一起来到这里，并与拥有如此强大文化的人们在一起，这与我们在欧洲的文化不同，这也非常好，我们真的很享受。我们从一开始就感受到了大家的热烈欢迎。 “能够来到那里，享受在一起的时光，在不同的环境中更好地了解彼此，真是太棒了。” 这次旅行对 Bompastor 来说特别特别，因为她能够和孩子们一起体验，孩子们也加入了这次旅行的团队。这让这位法国女子对切尔西表示感谢，因为她再次证明了俱乐部如何支持员工并在团队内营造家庭氛围。 “对我来说，我认为作为一名女性，这至关重要，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “我感到非常幸运，有一个俱乐部在这方面支持我，并且能够承担很多责任来完成我的工作。 “这是一份全职工作，但他们允许我带着我的孩子一起踏上这段旅程，让他们有机会体验这次旅行、这次旅行。 “那里的文化如此浓厚，对我来说能够与我的孩子们分享这种文化，我认为它是如此特别和独特。我感到很幸运能够做到这一点。 “我要感谢我的俱乐部给了我这样做的机会，我想鼓励更多的女性能够在职业工作和个人生活之间找到适当的平衡。 “对我来说，这份工作非常紧张。有很多责任，但我的家人就在我身边，能够体验这些旅行和旅行，我认为这给了我适当的平衡。 “这让我有机会有时停下来，而不是总是百分百专注于足球。这意味着我可以成为最好的自己。

news.title: Be first to experience Stamford Bridge's new VR Adventure - Mission: Into The Blue
news.title_zh: 抢先体验斯坦福桥的全新 VR 冒险 - 任务：进入蓝色 (Mission: Into The Blue)
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is set to take fans on a journey unlike any before with the launch of Mission: Into The Blue, an immersive virtual reality experience debuting this summer at Chelsea FC Museum & Tours, the first of its kind offered by a London club. From creating unforgettable moments on the pitch and competing at the highest level of world football, Chelsea FC has always embraced innovation and ambition. Now, the club is introducing a new way for supporters to connect with the Blues, transporting them beyond Stamford Bridge and into an entirely new dimension through cutting-edge VR technology. Designed for fans of all ages, Mission: Into The Blue combines imagination, innovation and Chelsea pride in a unique interactive adventure. Family-friendly and suitable for visitors young and old, the experience invites participants to step into a thrilling virtual mission that goes far beyond SW6, creating exciting moments to enjoy together and memories that will last long after the headset comes off. The experience can be enjoyed as part of the popular Stadium Tour, adding an exciting new dimension to a visit to Stamford Bridge, or booked as a standalone attraction. Whether visitors are lifelong supporters, families looking for a fun day out, or discovering Chelsea for the first time, Mission: Into The Blue promises an unforgettable adventure. With launch scheduled soon, fans are encouraged to register their interest now (using the form below) to be among the first to receive updates and gain access to an exclusive priority booking window before tickets go on general sale.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部将推出“Mission: Into The Blue”，带领球迷踏上一段前所未有的旅程，这是一种身临其境的虚拟现实体验，将于今年夏天在切尔西足球俱乐部博物馆和旅游中心首次亮相，这是伦敦俱乐部首次提供此类体验。从在球场上创造令人难忘的时刻到参加世界足球最高水平的比赛，切尔西足球俱乐部始终拥抱创新和雄心。现在，俱乐部正在推出一种让支持者与蓝军联系的新方式，通过尖端的 VR 技术将他们带到斯坦福桥之外，进入一个全新的维度。 Mission: Into The Blue 专为所有年龄段的球迷设计，将想象力、创新和切尔西的自豪感融入到独特的互动冒险中。该体验适合家庭游客，适合年轻和年长的游客，邀请参与者踏入远远超出 SW6 范围的激动人心的虚拟任务，创造一起享受的激动人心的时刻，以及摘下耳机后仍将长久存在的回忆。这一体验可以作为热门体育场之旅的一部分来享受，为斯坦福桥之旅增添令人兴奋的新维度，也可以作为独立景点预订。无论游客是终生支持者、想要度过愉快一天的家庭，还是第一次探索切尔西，《使命：走进蔚蓝》都将带来难忘的冒险之旅。由于即将推出，我们鼓励粉丝立即注册（使用下面的表格），以便成为第一批收到更新信息的人，并在门票开始全面销售之前获得独家优先预订窗口。

news.title: Ryan Kavuma-McQueen completes loan switch
news.title_zh: 瑞安·卡武玛·麦奎因完成租借转换
news.body_en: Chelsea winger Ryan Kavuma-McQueen will spend the 2026/27 season on loan at Championship club Portsmouth. Kavuma-McQueen joined the Blues as an Under-8 and, having progressed through our Academy ranks, made his first-team debut as a substitute in the 7-0 win over Port Vale in last season’s FA Cup quarter-finals. The 17-year-old was also included in Xabi Alonso's squad for our summer tour of Australia and Asia, starting in our opening fixture, a 6-4 victory over A-League side Western Sydney Wanderers. Kavuma-McQueen became a regular for Chelsea Under-18s while still a schoolboy and played an important role for our Under-21s as we finished top of the Premier League 2 table in 2025/26. He also scored twice in the Under-18 Premier League national final win over Manchester City at Stamford Bridge. We look forward to monitoring and supporting Ryan’s development and wish him luck at Fratton Park.
news.body_zh: 切尔西边锋瑞恩·卡武马-麦奎因将在 2026/27 赛季租借至英冠俱乐部朴茨茅斯。卡武玛-麦奎因作为 8 岁以下球员加入蓝军，并在我们的青训营中晋级，并在上赛季足总杯四分之一决赛 7-0 战胜维尔港的比赛中作为替补登场，完成了他的一线队首秀。这位 17 岁的球员也入选了哈维·阿隆索的阵容，参加我们夏季澳大利亚和亚洲之旅，并在我们的首场比赛中首发，帮助球队 6-4 战胜了澳超球队西悉尼流浪者队。卡武玛-麦奎因还是一名学生时就成为了切尔西 18 岁以下青年队的常客，并在我们 21 岁以下青年队中发挥了重要作用，帮助我们在 2025/26 赛季夺得英超 2 队积分榜榜首。他还在斯坦福桥战胜曼城的 U-18 英超联赛全国决赛中梅开二度。我们期待监督和支持瑞安的发展，并祝他在弗拉顿公园好运。

news.title: Vera Jones signs new contract
news.title_zh: 维拉·琼斯签署新合同
news.body_en: Chelsea midfielder Vera Jones has put pen to paper on a new contract committing her future to the club until at least 2029. Having joined the Blues in the summer of 2024, the 18-year-old agreed her first professional contract with us in February of last year, and has now signed on for the next three years. On signing her new deal, Jones said: 'I'm really pleased to be renewing my contract at Chelsea. I've enjoyed my time so far, and I'm really looking forward to seeing what's to come and continuing to learn and grow. I've had a lot of support from everyone at the club, including the academy. 'I hope to make my debut soon, get that first goal, and then eventually play at Stamford Bridge.' Jones spent the 2025/26 campaign on loan in the Women’s Super League 2 with Bristol City, where she gained valuable experience in the senior game by making 22 appearances, five of them from the start. She has also featured internationally for England at youth level, most recently scoring for the Under-20s in a 1-1 draw with the USA in July.

news.title: Chelsea FC Women and Fertility Plus launch new partnership to support players and champion fertility awareness
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部女子足球俱乐部与 Fertility Plus 建立新的合作伙伴关系，以支持球员并倡导生育意识
news.body_en: Chelsea FC Women is proud to announce a new partnership with Fertility Plus, one of London’s leading fertility clinics, as the club’s Official Fertility Partner. As a club, Chelsea Women want to set the standard when it comes to player care in women’s football. While we have made great strides in enhancing support for players to optimise their on-pitch performance, we are now going further to provide holistic support for their health and wellbeing off the football field as well. Fertility Plus provides personalised fertility care, and their dedicated medical team combine clinical excellence with compassionate, consultant-led care. This partnership will see the introduction of a new first-of-its-kind fund available to every women’s team player that will provide bespoke fertility support including assessments, treatments, counselling and workshops through Fertility Plus. With their world-class expertise, Fertility Plus will provide our players with a framework that will empower them with knowledge and tailor support to their personal needs. Chelsea FC Women and Fertility Plus also share an ambition to challenge common misconceptions about fertility with medical facts, and contribute to improved understanding. A study looking at the Fertility Knowledge Gap - published last year by UCLH - found that 41% of respondents actively trying to conceive did not know when their fertile window was. We want to close that knowledge gap, raise awareness about reproductive health and support women in making informed decisions when they think about starting a family. Together, Fertility Plus and Chelsea FC Women will also work to promote evidence-based information that empowers our players, as well as the wider Chelsea family, with the knowledge they need to make informed choices around their fertility. With expert-led educational content, myth vs medicine resources and CFCW ambassador insights, we want to change the conversation around fertility and ensure women feel informed and confident when navigating their fertility journey. Giulia Mazzia, commercial director for Chelsea FC Women, said: ‘At Chelsea FC Women we are never done pushing for progress for our players and our community. This first-of-its-kind partnership with Fertility Plus will open up the conversation about fertility, help to raise awareness for our incredible fanbase and beyond, and give practical support to our players off the field as well as on it.’ Dr Amit Shah and Dr Anil Gudi, co-founders of Fertility Plus, said: 'Elite sport asks a lot of women during the very years when fertility matters most, yet it's a conversation the game has rarely had. Partnering with Chelsea FC Women allows us to help change that by giving players, staff and supporters access to trusted fertility expertise and compassionate, consultant-led care. We're proud to work alongside a club that's setting a new standard for supporting women's health, both on and off the pitch.’ ¹ Wainwright et al. (2025). news.title: Cole Palmer reveals truth behind Morgan Rogers’ celebration: ‘He did it first!’

news.body_en:
In the latest episode of CFC Unlocked, which CFC+ subscribers can watch now, Cole Palmer discusses the story behind the ‘cold’ celebration he and his new Chelsea team-mate Morgan Rogers use after scoring.
 Palmer spoke exclusively to us while the men’s team were on tour in Hong Kong last week for the newest CFC Unlocked podcast. In the interview, our No10 discusses his summer break, his Chelsea career so far and when he found out his great mate Rogers would be joining him at Stamford Bridge. ‘He messaged me saying "where are you?" and he was with England, so I didn’t know why he was thinking about where I was,’ Palmer reveals. ‘I got a missed call and he messaged me straight away that I had five minutes to ring him back. I’m thinking, "he must need to tell me something". I went downstairs and I rang him. He told me he was coming, but I didn’t believe him at first. He told me and I was gassed.’ The footballing world is familiar with Palmer’s iconic celebration he uses after scoring, but it was in fact his old friend Rogers who inspired him. ‘I can’t remember how it came about, we were speaking about it and he told me to do it,’ says Palmer. ‘He did it first. He played midweek, then we played Luton on the Saturday and I told him I was going to do it. I bet he wishes I didn’t do it now! ‘He did it first, but I made it famous! That’s the truth. He says that as well!’ CFC+ subscribers can watch the full interview with Cole Palmer above and find the rest of the CFC Unlocked archive here. news.title: Palmer tells CFC Unlocked his cage football roots made him the player he is today
news.title_zh: 帕尔默告诉《CFC Unlocked》，他的笼式足球根源使他成为了今天的球员
news.body_en: Cole Palmer is the latest Chelsea player to sit down for a chat in the new episode of CFC Unlocked, discussing his childhood introduction to football and how it shaped his approach to the game. Joining the podcast in Hong Kong during the Blues’ pre-season tour of Asia and Australia, our No10 discussed a wide range of subjects, including the addition of his old friend Morgan Rogers to the Chelsea squad, as well as providing his own unique solutions to supporters’ personal dilemmas. Palmer also spoke about how he first started playing football as a youngster growing up in Manchester. When asked what he was like as a child, he went on to explain how he began playing cage football in his local park. ‘I was happy. My mum always said I was a happy kid, just normal,’ Cole began. ‘I was just like a normal kid, I just used to play out, go into the ramps and that, because I used to live ten seconds away from a park. So I used to just go on the ramps with scooters and bikes and whatever. ‘And there used to be a cage next to it, so we just used to flip between the two, just chill outside the shops, do whatever.’ Those games against all comers – and all ages – had a lasting impact on his development, one he believes has had a positive effect on his career since. ‘It was always older kids than me. To be fair, it helped me, because if I didn't play with them then I probably wouldn't be as good as I am now. ‘They didn't like it if you beat them and they wouldn’t go easy on you. They didn't care that you were younger, they just didn't think about that. ‘So naturally I learned skills that you wouldn't probably do at that age, like protecting the ball. That was a big thing I did when I was little, learning how to use my body. ‘When you're just playing all day from morning to night, with all different people, older people, I think it helps you. And it's obviously enjoyable.’ CFC+ subscribers can watch the full interview with Cole Palmer above and find the rest of the CFC Unlocked archive here. news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默是最新一期《CFC Unlocked》中坐下来聊天的切尔西球员，讨论了他童年时期接触足球的经历以及这如何塑造了他的比赛方式。在蓝军亚洲和澳大利亚季前赛期间，我们的 10 号球员在香港加入了播客，讨论了广泛的话题，包括他的老朋友摩根·罗杰斯加入切尔西队，以及为支持者的个人困境提供了自己独特的解决方案。帕尔默还谈到了他小时候在曼彻斯特长大时如何开始踢足球的。当被问及他小时候是什么样子时，他接着解释了他是如何开始在当地公园玩笼式足球的。 '我很高兴。我妈妈总是说我是一个快乐的孩子，很正常，”科尔开始说道。 “我就像一个普通的孩子一样，我只是出去玩，进入坡道等等，因为我以前住的地方距离公园只有十秒钟的路程。所以我过去只是骑着踏板车和自行车之类的东西走上坡道。 “旁边曾经有一个笼子，所以我们只是在两者之间切换，只是在商店外面放松一下，做任何事情。”那些与所有来者和所有年龄段的人进行的比赛对他的发展产生了持久的影响，他相信此后对他的职业生涯产生了积极的影响。 “总是比我大的孩子。公平地说，这对我很有帮助，因为如果我不和他们一起打球，我可能不会像现在这么好。 “如果你打败他们，他们就不喜欢，他们也不会宽待你。他们不在乎你年轻，他们只是没有考虑到这一点。 “所以很自然地，我学到了在那个年纪可能不会做的技能，比如护球。这是我小时候做过的一件大事，学习如何使用我的身体。 “当你从早到晚和不同的人、老年人一起玩一整天时，我认为这对你有帮助。这显然是令人愉快的。”CFC+ 订阅者可以观看上面对 Cole Palmer 的完整采访，并在此处找到 CFC Unlocked 档案的其余部分。如果您尚未订阅，这里有您需要的有关 CFC+ 的所有信息以及如何注册以获得独家内容和现场足球比赛的信息。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on Ellie Carpenter’s ‘positive vibes’
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特谈艾莉·卡彭特的“积极氛围”
news.body_en:
Sonia Bompastor says she and her players benefitted from Ellie Carpenter’s local insight during their time in Australia, with the head coach explaining the defender’s energy on and off the pitch is a great asset to this Chelsea side.
 Carpenter was born in Cowra in New South Wales, around 190 miles west of Sydney. As she pursed her sporting dream, her family moved to Sydney when she was young, so it is a city she knows well. It made sense, then, that during the Blues' time there on our pre-season tour of New Zealand and Australia, Carpenter made sure to show off the beauty of her homeland to the rest of the travelling party. ‘It was good to have Ellie show us around,’ said Bompastor. ‘She wanted the team to experience a lot of different things. She brought the team to the sunrise at Bondi Beach, and it was beautiful. The things they do together are really natural, and she’s always making sure people are connecting to each other. ‘Off the pitch, she’s a really happy person. She's always smiling. She brings these positive vibes into the group. Bompastor added: ‘The energy she brings on the pitch is really good. She's an important player for us. We worked together before, and she brings a lot of quality to the pitch. ‘She's a player who has a lot of physicality, but also she's really working hard on the tactics and the technicality of her game. I’m really happy to have Ellie at Chelsea.’
news.body_zh:
索尼娅·邦帕斯特表示，她和她的球员在澳大利亚期间从埃莉·卡彭特对当地的洞察力中受益匪浅，主教练解释说，这位后卫在球场内外的能量对这支切尔西队来说是一笔巨大的财富。
 卡彭特出生于新南威尔士州的考拉，距悉尼以西约 190 英里。当她追求自己的体育梦想时，她的家人在她年轻的时候就搬到了悉尼，所以这是一个她熟悉的城市。因此，在蓝调队参加新西兰和澳大利亚季前赛期间，卡彭特一定要向其他旅行团成员展示她祖国的美丽，这是有道理的。 “艾莉带我们四处参观真是太好了，”邦帕斯特说。 “她希望团队能够体验很多不同的事情。她带着团队去看了邦迪海滩的日出，景色很美。他们一起做的事情非常自然，她总是确保人们相互联系。 “在场外，她是一个非常快乐的人。她总是微笑着。她将这些积极的氛围带入了团队。邦帕斯特补充道：“她在球场上带来的能量非常好。她对我们来说是一位重要的球员。我们之前曾合作过，她为球场带来了很多品质。 “她是一名身体素质很强的球员，但她在比赛的战术和技术方面也非常努力。我真的很高兴埃莉来到切尔西。”

news.title: How Real Sociedad shaped Xabi Alonso’s career
news.title_zh: 皇家社会如何塑造哈维·阿隆索的职业生涯
news.body_en: As Chelsea prepare to host Real Sociedad in Xabi Alonso's first home game as Blues manager, we recap the formative role our opponents played in the Spaniard's development as a player and a coach. The Blues kick off our final match of pre-season against Real Sociedad at 2pm on Saturday, when Alonso will be leading the team from the Stamford Bridge dugout for the first time, with tickets still available on general sale here. Alonso’s links to Real Sociedad start before he was even born, with his father Periko Alonso joining them as a player in 1977. In 1981, the year of Xabi’s birth, Periko won his and Sociedad’s first-ever La Liga title. The next season they made it back-to-back titles, with those two triumphs remaining the only top-flight league wins in the club's history. After leaving Barcelona, where he won another title, Periko moved his family back to San Sebastian – home to Saturday’s opponents – when his playing career came to an end, meaning Xabi grew up with Sociedad as his local club. It was only natural, then, that the young midfielder would start his professional career by joining the youth ranks of Real Socieded, as his older brother Mikel Alonso had. Xabi quickly progressed to make his senior debut at the age of 18 but, after a brief spell with his father as caretaker manager, it was under the guidance of legendary Welsh coach John Toshack that his career really took off. Toshack was so impressed he made Alonso his Real Sociedad captain at the age of just 19 in the midst of a fierce relegation battle. Under the young midfielder’s leadership, Sociedad’s fortunes improved dramatically, as they established themselves in La Liga’s midtable. Toshack recognised his skipper’s potential to the extent of arranging personalised training sessions based around his development, later claiming: ‘I invested a lot of time and effort into Xabi’s development, but it was worth every moment. Everyone seemed to play better when he was on the pitch’. Better still was to come. In 2003 Real Sociedad finished second in La Liga, just two points behind winners Real Madrid. It marked their best season since Alonso’s father had worn the shirt, and secured the club’s first-ever qualification for the UEFA Champions League. Alonso’s contribution was clear, netting 12 goals from midfield that season and receiving the Best Spanish Player award from newspaper Don Balon. Spain manager Inaki Saez was impressed, calling Xabi up to his senior squad while claiming he ‘sees football with an extraordinary clarity’. That is a quality which continued to serve Alonso well as a player and a manager. Meanwhile, the midfielder was now being referred to as ‘Don Xabi’ by the Sociedad supporters – and stadium announcer – as they embarked on a memorable Champions League debut. Opening wins over Olympiacos and Galatasaray – Alonso getting the winning goal in the latter – along with a battling home draw with Juventus secured their place in the knockout rounds at the first attempt. The additional workload eventually took its toll an a relatively small squad unused to competing in Europe, with a last-16 exit to Lyon in the Champions League and 15th-place finish in La Liga, but Alonso’s performances had again been of the highest level, prompting Liverpool to edge out Real Madrid in a bidding war for his signature. Xabi Alonso’s Real Sociedad story wasn’t quite finished yet, though. After hanging up his boots, the Spaniard returned to San Sebastian to manage Real Sociedad B. It was there he got his first taste of managerial success. In his second season, he guided them to victory in the play-offs, securing the team’s promotion to the second division for the first time since 1962. That kicked off a managerial career which has now brought him to west London and the Chelsea dugout. How fitting, then, that things will come full circle, with Real Sociedad being the opponents for Xabi Alonso’s first home game at Stamford Bridge. Tickets for Saturday's friendly against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge are now on general sale!
news.body_zh: 当切尔西准备在哈维·阿隆索作为蓝军主教练的第一场主场比赛中迎战皇家社会队时，我们回顾一下我们的对手在西班牙人作为球员和教练的发展过程中所扮演的重要角色。蓝军将于周六下午 2 点与皇家社会队进行季前赛最后一场比赛，届时阿隆索将首次在斯坦福桥教练席上带领球队，门票仍在此处公开发售。阿隆索与皇家社会的联系在他出生之前就已经开始了，他的父亲佩里科·阿隆索于 1977 年作为球员加入皇家社会。1981 年，也就是哈维出生的那一年，佩里科赢得了他和皇家社会队的第一个西甲冠军。接下来的赛季，他们连续获得冠军，这两次胜利仍然是俱乐部历史上唯一的顶级联赛胜利。在离开巴塞罗那并再次赢得冠军后，佩里科将家人搬回了圣塞巴斯蒂安——周六对手的家乡——当他的职业生涯结束时，这意味着哈维是在皇家社会作为他的当地俱乐部长大的。那么，这位年轻的中场球员很自然地会像他的哥哥米克尔·阿隆索一样，加入皇家社会的青年队开始他的职业生涯。哈维很快就在 18 岁时首次亮相成年队，但在父亲短暂担任看守教练后，在威尔士传奇教练约翰·托沙克的指导下，他的职业生涯真正腾飞。托沙克对此印象深刻，他在激烈的保级战中任命年仅 19 岁的阿隆索为皇家社会队长。在这位年轻中场球员的领导下，皇家社会的命运得到了巨大的改善，他们在西甲联赛中站稳了脚跟。托沙克认识到了他的队长的潜力，根据他的发展安排了个性化的训练课程，后来声称：“我在 Xabi 的发展上投入了大量的时间和精力，但每一刻都是值得的。”当他在场上时，每个人似乎都踢得更好。”更好的事情还在后头。 2003年，皇家社会在西甲联赛中排名第二，仅落后冠军皇家马德里两分。这是自阿隆索的父亲穿上这件球衣以来他们最好的一个赛季，并确保了俱乐部首次获得欧洲冠军联赛的资格。阿隆索的贡献显而易见，该赛季在中场打入 12 粒进球，并获得《Don Balon》报纸颁发的最佳西班牙球员奖。西班牙主帅伊纳基·萨斯对此印象深刻，他将哈维招入自己的一线队，并声称他“对足球有​​着非凡的清晰度”。这种品质一直让阿隆索无论是作为球员还是教练都受益匪浅。与此同时，这位中场球员现在被皇家社会的支持者和体育场播音员称为“Don Xabi”，因为他们开始了令人难忘的冠军联赛首秀。首场比赛战胜了奥林匹亚科斯和加拉塔萨雷——阿隆索在后者中攻入致胜进球——加上主场战平尤文图斯，首次锁定了淘汰赛席位。额外的工作量最终对一支不习惯参加欧洲比赛的相对较小的球队造成了影响，在冠军联赛中16强被里昂淘汰，在西甲联赛中获得第15名，但阿隆索的表现再次达到了最高水平，促使利物浦在与他签约的竞标战中击败了皇家马德里。不过，哈维·阿隆索的皇家社会故事还没有完全结束。挂靴后，西班牙人回到圣塞巴斯蒂安执教皇家社会B队。正是在那里，他第一次尝到了执教成功的滋味。在他的第二个赛季，他带领球队在附加赛中取得胜利，确保球队自 1962 年以来首次晋升乙级联赛。这开启了他的执教生涯，现在他来到了伦敦西部和切尔西教练席。那么，事情将会圆满结束，这是多么恰当的事情，皇家社会队将成为哈维·阿隆索在斯坦福桥的第一场主场比赛的对手。周六在斯坦福桥对阵皇家社会队的友谊赛门票现已全面发售！

news.title: Sjoeke Nusken on her goal and a productive tour on and off the pitch
news.title_zh: Sjoeke Nusken 讲述她的进球以及球场内外富有成效的旅程
news.body_en: Sjoeke Nusken was one of the goalscorers in our 3-0 win against the A-League All-Stars, and she reflected afterwards on the game and our pre-season tour overall. The midfielder netted our second in the victory at the Allianz Stadium, which brought an end to our time in Australasia in positive fashion. It was a typically predatory Nusken finish, with the German showcasing excellent technique to steer her effort on target. ‘As a midfielder you need to go into the box, and I saw the ball coming and I just tried to hit it,’ said Nusken. ‘It was a little bit of luck I think that the ball went in! Overall it was a good game from the team. It was a nice way to end the tour here.’ It’s clearly been a productive ten days or so for Sonia Bompastor and her squad, with bonds forged off the pitch and connections created on it. It was also a chance to celebrate the global Chelsea family and meet some of our supporters from further afield, something Nusken appreciated. ‘It was really cool to see all the Chelsea fans here on the other side of the world, the atmospheres were really nice, and the support is amazing. ‘We had two good opponents, two good games. We’re happy. We can take the team performances into the next games. Everyone did really good. It’s good to have these two games and to be around the team the whole time to build up our team cohesion.’
news.body_zh: Sjoeke Nusken 是我们 3-0 战胜 A 联赛全明星队的进球者之一，她赛后回顾了这场比赛和我们季前赛的整体情况。这名中场球员在安联球场的胜利中攻入了我们的第二粒进球，以积极的方式结束了我们在澳大利亚的时光。这是努斯肯典型的掠夺性终结，德国人展示了出色的技术来引导她的射门击中目标。 “作为一名中场球员，你需要进入禁区，我看到球来了，我就试图射门，”努斯肯说。 “我认为球进了有点运气！总的来说，这是球队的一场精彩比赛。对于索尼娅·邦帕斯特和她的球队来说，这显然是富有成效的十天左右，他们在球场外建立了联系，在球场上也建立了联系。这也是一个庆祝全球切尔西大家庭并会见来自更远地方的一些支持者的机会，努斯肯对此表示赞赏。 “在世界的另一边看到所有切尔西球迷真的很酷，气氛真的很好，支持也很棒。 “我们有两个优秀的对手，两场精彩的比赛。我们很高兴。我们可以将球队的表现带入接下来的比赛。每个人都做得非常好。能够参加这两场比赛并一直陪伴在球队周围以增强我们球队的凝聚力，这很好。”

news.title: Attacker edges tight Star of the Match vote
news.title_zh: 攻击者在比赛之星投票中险胜
news.body_en: Chelsea supporters have chosen Alyssa Thompson as our Star of the Match against the A-League All-Stars - but only just! The attacker had a hand in our first two goals in Sydney - scored by Sandy Baltimore and Sjoeke Nusken - and she received 29 per cent of an incredibly tight vote on the Chelsea Official App. Thompson was a constant attacking threat during our 3-0 victory, which rounded off our pre-season tour of New Zealand and Australia in style. The USA international was very closely followed in the vote by goalscorers Baltimore, who picked up 27 per cent of the vote, and Lexi Potter, who bagged our third and received 23 per cent.
news.body_zh: 切尔西的支持者选择艾莉莎·汤普森作为我们对阵澳超全明星队的比赛之星 - 但仅此而已！这位攻击手参与了我们在悉尼的前两粒进球——由桑迪·巴尔的摩和斯乔克·努斯肯打进——她在切尔西官方应用程序上获得了 29% 的得票率。在我们以 3-0 获胜的过程中，汤普森始终保持着进攻威胁，为我们新西兰和澳大利亚的季前赛之旅画上了圆满的句号。这位美国国脚在投票中紧随其后的是射手巴尔的摩，他们获得了 27% 的选票；而莱克西·波特则获得了第三名，获得了 23% 的选票。
